newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: GAMMA BUYS CONVEYOR BELT MAKER IN U.S> .
newsitem.headline: GAMMA BUYS CONVEYOR BELT MAKER IN U.S> .

text.p: Textiles firm Gamma Holding NV said on Monday it had agreed to take over conveyor belt maker Chemprene Holding Inc. in the U.S.
Chemprene is based in the state of New York and produces conveyor belts and coated industrial products for the food and packaging industries.
The company has 170 employees and posted 1996 turnover of about 60 million guilders, Gamma said in a statement.
Gamma said the takeover would significantly strenghten the market position of its subsidiary Ammeraal Conveyor Belting in the U.S.
Combining Chemprene's and Ammeraal's specific technical know-how and commercial activities could also create the basis for further growth, it added.
Ammeraal has a world-wide network for sales, distribution and service. Gamma said Chemprene would remain active as an independently working unit under its present management.
No financial details of the transaction were disclosed.
